title: Automatic Crack Segmentation in Electroluminescence Images of Solar Modules and Maximum Inactive Area Prediction
mechanism: After segmenting cracks and busbars, compute the worst-case inactive area: cell regions that cracks cut off from every busbar (a circuit prior on where inactive can occur).
adaptation: From house/PF predictions of crack + ribbons + border, close crack gaps, then mark cell components not connected to any ribbon as 'isolatable'. Use as a post-hoc gate on inactive (suppress outside, lower threshold inside) and, if it helps, as input to a small second-stage inactive head. Fits E: 99% of inactive regions touch a crack. Half-cut E1 ribbon geometry handled natively.
min_experiment: Step 1, no training: apply the gate to existing PF 5-seed ensemble predictions on val and the module-grouped 5-fold CV roots; metric inactive IoU/precision/recall; kill if CV inactive IoU gain < +0.02; read E1 inactive IoU once at the end. Step 2: second-stage head with the isolatable map as input vs PF baseline, same kill line on top of step 1.
evidence: R: UNet on 1,272 train / 206 val / 359 test cells, test F1 0.875, IoU 0.782 for crack lines, cross cracks, busbars, dark areas; isolated-area algorithm given, no accuracy figure for it in the abstract.
prior_overlap: none. BRIEF lists refinement networks and physics priors as never tried; no circuit-consistency rule on inactive was tested.

alt_notes.adaptation: Post-evaluation layer on our crack + ribbon/busbar predictions; compare predicted isolated area with labelled inactive fraction per cell on test and E1 to define power-loss bands.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Zero training: run on existing predictions; Spearman correlation of isolated area vs labelled inactive fraction; keep as a severity metric if rho > 0.6.

alt_notes.adaptation: Severity output for the benchmark: per-cell potential inactive fraction from predicted crack + busbar masks, reported next to measured inactive fraction; also the region generator for the crack-bounded inactive prior.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Same arm as the PV-Vision inactive prior (post-processing, CV inactive IoU, kill < +0.02); for the benchmark, report correlation of potential vs labelled inactive fraction on CV.
